_note: AUTHORED CONTENT, not extracted. The closing call to action every page ends on, following the house rule that every page ends with a CTA banner. Tone and shape mirror the equivalent blocks on the IFS Coatings US site (content/markets/*.md, type: cta): an action heading, one line on what the representative can provide, and a button. The button label reuses the site's own existing term, Contactenos. `default` carries every page that has no entry of its own - the product, resource and legal pages - and the named entries name their market. Written for this project and NOT migrated from the old site, so it needs a review before launch.
